title: STRANGE MINUTE · WHAT IF #5

lines.text: What if GTA 6 broke the internet?
lines.say: What if G.T.A. six broke the internet?

lines.text: Today it finally launched. After two delays.
It unlocks at midnight, one time zone at a time.
Its first trailer hit 90 million views in one day.
lines.say: Its first trailer hit ninety million views in one day.

lines.text: No non-music video had ever done that.
Then the pre-orders. Analysts estimate 19 million copies.
lines.say: Then the pre-orders. Analysts estimate nineteen million copies.

lines.text: Roughly 1.8 billion dollars, before day one even ended.
lines.say: Roughly one point eight billion dollars, before day one even ended.

lines.text: GTA 5's first day made 815 million. A world record.
lines.say: G.T.A. five's first day made eight hundred fifteen million. A world record.

lines.text: GTA 5 has now sold over 230 million copies.
lines.say: G.T.A. five has now sold over two hundred thirty million copies.

lines.text: Last night, PlayStation players hit sign-in trouble.
The strange part? GTA 5 came out in 2013.
lines.say: The strange part? G.T.A. five came out in twenty thirteen.

lines.text: Some fans waited longer than some players have been alive.
So is the internet really broken right now?
